subject: [PATCH v3 1/8] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch detects and handles zonelist rebuilds caused by memory hot-add, which can lead to spurious allocation failures for __GFP_THISNODE callers. The issue arises when onlining a zone's first block rewrites the zonelists in place, causing intermediate list states that can be observed by concurrent allocations. To fix this, the patch gates sequence checks on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG, which covers all configurations that rebuild zonelists after boot. This change ensures that allocation failures are avoided even when memory is being added to a node.
